messages:
alex.pm: FY26 Q2 OKR draft attached — focused on two company-level outcomes: 1) Reduce per-inference unit cost by 20% vs baseline, 2) Ship Private (VPC/on-prem) pilot for regulated customers with SLA. Need quick alignment on prioritization vs Dedicated capacity work and launch criteria. Please review and raise blockers by EOD Fri. Doc: https://redwood-internal/okrs/q2-slate (short link)

tara: Thanks Alex — can you call out customer-driven asks that force a private-first path? also we need a crisp launch checklist we can share with sales.

kevin.sales: Two committed pilots asking for Private w/ SLA: FinServeCo (regulatory deadline Sep) and HealthSys (data residency). Both expect a canary in prod and audit logs. They'd pay for early access if we can commit to a timeline.

jon: High level — we need to understand the cost of pulling infra bandwidth from Dedicated work. Current infra sprint has 3 large tickets that help throughput timing. If Private pilot delays Dedicated improvements, unit-cost OKR could slip.

maria.eng: To be concrete: quantization + compiler kernel tuning is ~6 wks for 1 eng FTE focused, or 10-12 wks split across team. KV-cache + prefix-caching improvements are another ~4 wks.

sam.sre: Heads-up: Private pilots increase oncall surface (customer-specific networking, KMS integrations). We should add a support SLO and escalation playbook or we'll burn SRE.

ravi.research: Re quality: aggressive quantization risks generation quality drop. Recommend a mandatory eval gate: compare baseline and quantized model with specific prompt set. Suggested metric: token-level KL / perplexity delta + manual review for 50 customer prompts.

danny.ops: Proposed launch criteria (for product + sales to verify):
```
- Canary customers signed and scoped (names + success metrics)
- Eval gate passed (no >2% quality regression on core prompts)
- SLA doc + oncall rotation + runbook ready
- Data residency & KMS integration validated in staging
- Rollout rollback plan + fallback model ready
```

alex.pm: Good notes — my suggested tradeoff: prioritize Private pilot for those 2 customers while continuing Dedicated perf work but at reduced cadence. Proposed timeline: start infra focused sprints next Mon, target canary in 8 weeks. Action items: 1) Eng to confirm FTE and timeline, 2) Research to define eval prompts by Tue, 3) Sales to confirm canary commitments. If we get a :thumbsup: from Eng + SRE + Sales by Fri EOD, we'll lock the plan.

tara: :thumbsup: conditional on eval gate + 0.5 FTE from infra for the first 6 weeks.

jon: :thumbsup: we can reassign 1 engineer from Dedicated for 6 wks, but we need explicit success criteria and a rollback window.

release-bot: Calendar event created: "Q2 OKR alignment — Private pilot tradeoffs" Tue 10:00am — invites: alex.pm, tara, jon, maria.eng, kevin.sales, sam.sre, ravi.research, danny.ops.

kevin.sales: :thumbsup: I'll confirm FinServeCo's canary willingness and send a short MOU by Thurs.

alex.pm: Thanks everyone — I'll update the doc with the launch checklist and a proposed timeline tonight and ping this thread when done. Requesting final sign-off by Fri EOD so PM can ship the schedule to Sales + Legal.
